variants.title: Millikan's oil-drop experiment by the rise-and-fall method
variants.sample: Oil drops in Millikan's chamber, plates at a fixed 500 V
variants.note: Each drop is timed falling with the plates shorted and rising with 500 V across them; q = 6 pi eta a (vg + vr) d / V. Air viscosity 1.81e-5 Pa s is from memory - verify; the oil density and the chamber sizes are illustrative.

source.title: A. C. Melissinos and J. Napolitano, Experiments in Modern Physics: the Millikan oil-drop experiment
source.note: cited from memory, not fetched - verify
